necessary_context.content: x∈R^d; f=(1/n)sum_i f_i, F=f+h. Each f_i is differentiable, convex and has L-Lipschitz gradient; the selected strongly convex result requires every f_i to be mu-strongly convex. h is convex with an available proximal minimizer. Norms are Euclidean. x* is an attained minimizer of F.

necessary_context.name: Finite-sum composite setting
